extracted.name: Prosciutto and Fig Pizza
extracted.description: I tried this combination at Olives in Las Vegas and loved it. It was served as a flatbread. I adapted it as a pizza. #pizza #fun #vegas #prosciutto #cheese #gorgonzola #fig #finger #food #meal #dinner #tv #slice #baked #oven
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chopped chives (or 1 scallion thinly sliced)
instruction_lines: Put a pizza stone in the lower rack of the oven and preheat it to 500F for at least 45 minutes.
Roll out dough into a 20-in round.
Generously dust a pizza peel with flour. Place pizza on it.
Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle garlic and rosemary. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread fig jam all over except the borders. Distribute 2/3 of the Gorgonzola and 2/3 of the prosciutto over the pizza.
Carefully hit the peel sideways to loosen the bottom of the pizza. Slide it onto the stone and bake for 8 minutes until puffed and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing. Add rest of prosciutto and Gorgonzola. Put back in oven for 5 minutes. Sprinkle chives and serve.
